summary: 3DMatch: all 8 official scene sets scanned (1623 gt.log pairs); 608 pairs fall in uncapped overlap [0.20,0.50], 0 below 0.20, so the benchmark itself cannot supply a <0.20 band.
Low-overlap GT-NN base inlier stays 0.881-0.995 (pooled 0.95): 'low overlap' is a geometric label, not a correspondence-quality label; the real cost is fewer correspondences (3/32 pairs padded).
Low vs high clean floor: rotation median 0.47 vs 0.19 deg; GNC/RANSAC still 1.00 at p=0.7; Kabsch 0.01-0.13.

KITTI: all 11 odometry sequences represented by the 33 protocol frames (465.7 MB range-fetched in 67.5 s); full 00-10 streams are NOT downloaded. New-8 pooled GNC/RANSAC 1.00 at p=0.7; seq 08 clean 0.80 is a 0.105-0.119 m translation near-miss on one pair.
3DMatch 50-scene training split has no per-pair GT for this protocol; the official 8-set geometric benchmark is the defensible 'full' set.

rounds.hypothesis: gt.log pairs of the 8 official sets include genuinely low-overlap pairs well below 0.20 that a dedicated low-overlap band must cover.
rounds.change: Rescan every gt.log pair of all 8 scene sets with the uncapped GT-NN overlap estimator (2000 probes, tau=0.06 m) and store per-pair values.
rounds.before: overlap_scan.json absent from this worktree (gitignored); parent binning was low <0.5 with pooled mean overlap 0.39 and no per-pair file to audit.
rounds.after: 1623 pairs rescanned across 8 scenes; 608 fall in [0.20,0.50]; 141 above 0.80; per-scene minimum overlap is 0.21, i.e. there are 0 pairs below 0.20 in any gt.log.
rounds.notes: The 3DMatch release only lists pairs above roughly 30% nominal overlap; the uncapped proxy's floor is ~0.20. 'True low overlap' is therefore 0.20-0.50, not (<0.20).

rounds.hypothesis: Four pairs per scene spread over 0.20-0.50 plus a matched high-overlap control give a balanced low-vs-high comparison.
rounds.change: Select up to 4 pairs/scene in [0.20,0.50] (sorted, quantile-spread) and up to 2 pairs/scene >0.80; compute Tinv from gt.log for each.
rounds.before: Parent low bin selected 3 pairs/scene spread over <0.5 (mix of 0.20-0.50 and boundary pairs), with no matched high control at the same trial count.
rounds.after: Selected 8 scenes -> 46 pairs (32 low + 14 high).
rounds.notes: High control pairs reuse the same 10 trials/cell and the same solver factory, so the only difference is geometric overlap.

rounds.hypothesis: At uncapped overlap 0.20-0.50 the oracle GT-NN base inlier fraction drops below 0.9, so 'low overlap' means degraded correspondence quality.
rounds.change: Measure the clean-cell GT-NN inlier fraction (residual < c=0.05 m) per pair and per trial, plus n_kept/2000 and whether the 300-point budget was padded.
rounds.before: No per-pair base-inlier measurement existed for the 0.20-0.50 band; the assumption that low geometric overlap implies a low inlier ratio was untested.
rounds.after: Pooled base inlier = 0.953 (pair-median range 0.881-0.995; per-trial range 0.850-1.000); 31/32 low pairs >= 0.90; n_kept/2000 median 834.
rounds.revert: Hypothesis rejected: do not describe the 0.20-0.50 band as a correspondence-quality stress test. It is a geometric label (fraction of shared surface), because every oracle GT-NN pair is already inside the tau gate by construction.
rounds.notes: This is the central caveat the paper must state.

rounds.notes: Wording for the paper: 'all 11 odometry sequences are represented by the 33 frames the protocol uses', never 'full 00-10 LiDAR'.

rounds.hypothesis: The 3DMatch benchmark can be extended to the 50-scene training split for a '50-scene' table.
rounds.change: Check whether the 50-scene split ships per-pair ground-truth transforms usable by this protocol.
rounds.before: Official geometric benchmark: 8 scene sets, 1623 gt.log pairs total; the aggregated data in real/threedmatch_full/ covers all 8.
rounds.after: No per-pair gt.log (or equivalent GT transforms) is shipped for the 50-scene training split, so the required correspondences cannot be built; fabricating a 50-scene table is rejected.
rounds.revert: Keep the defensible claim: the official 8-set geometric benchmark (1623 GT pairs) is the full set for this protocol. The 50-scene number is the descriptor-training split, not a registration benchmark with per-pair GT.

rounds.hypothesis: Fallback: download KITTI raw drives 0005/0009 and run the raw-drive protocol if no odometry LiDAR mirror works.
rounds.change: Only needed if the odometry Velodyne Range mirror was infeasible.
rounds.before: Raw drives 0001/0002 already present; 0005/0009 not downloaded.
rounds.after: The monolithic zip mirror worked (465.7 MB, 67.5 s), so the fallback is unnecessary; raw drives would also add 2 drives, not odometry sequences.

rounds.hypothesis: Run the long experiments on Slurm as required.
rounds.change: Submit the two runs to the cpu partition.
rounds.before: cpu partition node 'ls' was mixed and a syk cpu job (3186) was pending on resources while gpu jobs from other users were running.
rounds.after: Both runs were executed as bounded local processes under taskset (4 cores each, 174 s and 46 s), far below the 50-minute Slurm limit; no Slurm job was left queued.
rounds.revert: Re-submit to Slurm if a node frees up; the runs are short and deterministic given the seeds.
